name: budget-guidance-solo
description: Credential-free explicit managed-Python installation and offline posture/extension contracts from an exact local source snapshot; requires Python for candidate composition and Node.js 20+.
validates: Stamping creates a self-contained payload without provisioning the runtime.
Unprepared command use does not install; explicit snapshot setup prepares managed Python after the original source copy is removed.
Installed source/version identity, unavailable/static posture and caller-relative configuration under both uv directory aliases are preserved.
The installed snapshot's extension passes candidate-owned SDK fixtures without a live session or credentials.

config.CR_HARNESS_MOUNT: read-only local candidate checkout supplied with --harness-mount

stages.title: fresh credential-free environment and candidate source
explicit snapshot setup after removing the original copy
